info.headline: Coastal Hazard Warning for Southeast Coast forecast district
info.description:
LARGE AND POWERFUL SURF CONDITIONS are likely, which may lead to coastal erosion and localised damage to coastal infrastructure between Cape Moreton and the New South Wales border.
Beach conditions in these areas could be dangerous and people should stay well away from the surf and surf exposed areas.
These conditions are expected to ease by Monday afternoon.
Locations which may be affected include Gold Coast, and ocean-facing coasts of Moreton and North Stradbroke Islands.
Waves up to 6.6 metres were recorded at Brisbane monitoring site at 2:30 am on Monday.
A Hazardous Surf Warning is also current, refer to the latest warnings at www.bom.gov.au/qld/warnings/
info.instruction: Emergency services advise people to: * Know your limitations around beaches, tidal rivers and creeks. Adhere to warning from lifesavers and lifeguards . * If you have a boat or water craft, haul out if possible or check your moorings are secure. * If you have children make sure they are within arm's reach around the water.
